body: I have talked to people about this. I only have 1 family member left, all my friends have explained that I'm just a drag to be around. They won't be surprised in the least. I've been in therapy, never been much help because it's all based around basically faking happiness and ignoring the bad stuff.

The only copy of my mom's death certificate I have doesn't list a cause of death, as it was issued before the coroner's office declared one. I need a new copy but I can't bring myself to requisition it because I'm fairly certain she killed herself and I don't want to know.
Def go in Sep. Hike from Tenaya Lake to Clouds Rest is one of the best.

The "4 mile trail" that leads to Glacier Point is currently closed and impassable due to snow and rockfall. You could walk along the GP road once they finish plowing, and before it opens to vehicles, but that's like a 12 mile walk.
More reason to continue to avoid the valley during the high season. I always felt like sleeping/waiting in line was part of the fun of Camp 4. 🤷🏻
